en.title: Trump Demands Investigation Into Revised Third-Quarter GDP Figures
en.dek: President Donald Trump called for an immediate investigation into third-quarter gross domestic product data after the Commerce Department revised economic growth upward to 4.3 percent.
facts: President Donald Trump called the revised GDP data a mistake and demanded an immediate probe.
The Commerce Department revised third-quarter GDP growth upward to 4.3 percent from an initial 3.4 percent estimate.
Trump characterized the updated economic figures released before the midterm elections as fake.
body: President Donald Trump demanded an immediate investigation into third-quarter gross domestic product figures on Thursday after the federal government revised the growth numbers upward. Writing about the latest report from the Commerce Department, Trump called the updated figures a mistake that requires official inquiry. Reuters reported his demand for a probe, while lower courts and public agencies have not publicly responded to the request.

The Commerce Department released updated economic figures showing third-quarter GDP grew at an annualized rate of 4.3 percent. That measurement increased from an initial government estimate of 3.4 percent, according to reporting by The Hill and The Straits Times. The revised numbers came out in the period preceding the midterm elections.

Trump characterized the revised figures as fake when requesting the government investigation. He did not provide specific evidence of errors in the calculation process when he made the statements. Federal statistical agencies regularly publish revisions to quarterly gross domestic product numbers as additional economic data becomes available.
en.context: Gross domestic product measures the total value of goods and services produced within the United States, and the Commerce Department routinely updates these figures as more complete data arrives.

en.headline: Trump demands probe of GDP data released before midterms
en.body: President Donald Trump on Thursday deemed the latest gross domestic product revision a mistake, claiming that it should be "immediately investigated." According to Reuters, Trump demands probe of GDP data released before midterms. The Hill reports Trump calls for investigation into "fake" US GDP figures, stating the Commerce Department strongly revised GDP growth in the third quarter up to 4.3% from a 3.4% estimate.

de.headline: Trump fordert Untersuchung der vor den Zwischenwahlen veröffentlichten GDP-Daten
de.body: Präsident Donald Trump bezeichnete die jüngste Revision des Bruttoinlandsprodukts als Fehler und forderte eine sofortige Untersuchung. Nach Angaben von Reuters fordert Trump eine Untersuchung der vor den Zwischenwahlen veröffentlichten GDP-Daten. The Hill berichtet, Trump fordere eine Untersuchung der "falschen" US-GDP-Zahlen und behauptete, das Handelsministerium habe das BIP-Wachstum im dritten Quartal stark nach oben korrigiert von 3,4 auf 4,3 Prozent.

it.headline: Trump chiede indagine sui dati sul PIL diffusi prima delle elezioni di metà mandato
it.body: Il presidente Donald Trump ha definito l'ultima revisione del prodotto interno lordo un errore, sostenendo che dovrebbe essere "immediatamente indagata". Secondo Reuters, Trump chiede indagine sui dati sul PIL diffusi prima delle elezioni di metà mandato. The Hill riporta che Trump chiede un'indagine sui "falsi" dati PIL statunitensi, affermando che il Dipartimento del Commercio ha rivisto al rialzo la crescita del PIL nel terzo trimestre fino al 4,3% da una stima del 3,4%.

fr.headline: Trump demande une enquête sur les données du PIB publiées avant les élections de mi-mandat
fr.body: Le président Donald Trump a qualifié jeudi la dernière révision du produit intérieur brut d'erreur, affirmant qu'elle devait être "immédiatement investiguée". Selon Reuters, Trump demande une enquête sur les données du PIB publiées avant les élections de mi-mandat. The Hill rapporte que Trump appelle à une enquête sur les "faux" chiffres du PIB américain, affirmant que le Département du Commerce a révisé fortement la croissance du PIB au troisième trimestre à 4,3 % contre une estimation de 3,4 %.
